WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    BillingState, 
    COUNT(*) as invoice_count
  FROM Invoice
  WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BillingState
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(invoice_count) as total_count,
    AVG(invoice_count) as avg_count
  FROM grouped
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    g.invoice_count,
    g.invoice_count * 1.0 / s.total_count as share,
    g.invoice_count - s.avg_count as excess
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE g.invoice_count > s.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices_in_groups,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
